sloka: तस्यासनानि प्रासादान्वेदिकास्तोरणानि च ।पुष्पकस्य बभञ्जुस्ते शीघ्रं मधुकरा इव ।। ७.२१.२७ ॥
transliteration: tasyāsanāni prāsādānvedikāstoraṇāni ca ।puṣpakasya babhañjuste śīghraṁ madhukarā iva ।। 7.21.27 ॥

translations.english: They quickly shattered the seats, palaces, platforms, and archways of the Pushpaka chariot, just like bees.
